$comment: Canonical task schema for a Brain workspace's tasks/{tasks,habits}.csv. Brain seeds this file when a workspace has none and never overwrites an existing one. The CSVs always store lowercase machine values; display_labels below are for the UI tier only.

identity.task_uuid: immutable UUID merge identity; the key sync merges on
identity.task_id: mutable human-facing display identity; may be renumbered

columns.name: task_uuid
columns.description: Immutable identity. Never edited, never reused; sync merges rows on this.

columns.name: task_id
columns.description: Display identifier of the form T<n>. Disjoint from the habits H<n> namespace.

columns.name: task_name
columns.description: Short title.

columns.name: task_type
columns.description: Pipe-separated workspace-defined categories; one row may carry several. Values are yours to choose. Brain itself only recognizes 'mit' (most important task), which it strips and tracks separately.

columns.name: status
columns.description: 'waiting' means paused on an external party you do not control, which is distinct from an internal dependency recorded in blocked_by. 'backlog' means parked indefinitely and hidden from active views.

columns.name: waiting_since
columns.description: Date the row entered status='waiting'; cleared when it leaves. Drives the follow-up prompt for a wait that has run long.

columns.name: due_date
columns.description: ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM when the time matters.

columns.name: hard_deadline
columns.description: When true, never defer without explicit confirmation.

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Defer date. A row starting later than today is hidden from default views.

columns.name: assigned_to
columns.description: The workspace member this row belongs to, by portable user ID.

columns.name: see_also
columns.description: Free-form reference: a URL, a document title, brief context.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Free-form body.

columns.name: project
columns.description: Project slug; matches a directory under the workspace's projects/.

columns.name: context
columns.description: GTD-style context. Empty by default.

columns.name: blocked_by
columns.description: Pipe-separated task_ids this row depends on, for a dependency you own. For a pause on an external party use status='waiting'.

columns.name: defer_count
columns.description: Increments on each due-date push, except a no-penalty defer: status='waiting', a non-empty blocked_by, or an explicitly uncounted defer. A high count is the 'are we avoiding this?' signal.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Set on insert.

columns.name: completed_date
columns.description: Set when status becomes 'done'.

columns.name: last_touched
columns.description: ISO date the row was last meaningfully edited. Managed by Brain, not by hand; drives staleness detection.

columns.name: linear_issue
columns.description: Issue identifier when this row is mirrored into an external tracker. The issue URL, if kept, belongs in see_also.

columns.name: system_key
columns.description: Stable key for a row Brain manages itself. Empty for rows a person created.

columns.name: task_uuid
columns.description: Immutable identity of this occurrence.

columns.name: task_id
columns.description: Display identifier of the form H<n>. Completing a habit spawns the next occurrence with a fresh id.

columns.name: assigned_to
columns.description: The workspace member this occurrence belongs to, by portable user ID.

columns.name: ideal_time
columns.description: Preferred time of day. Empty means no preference; used to group and order the day's habits.

columns.name: recur_interval
columns.description: Number of recur_units between occurrences.

columns.name: completed_date
columns.description: When set, the next occurrence is appended with due_date advanced by recur_interval x recur_unit, anchored to the previous due date.

columns.name: system_key
columns.description: Stable key for an occurrence Brain manages itself.

enum_display_labels.$comment: Presentation only. Categories a workspace defines for itself, such as task_type, are deliberately absent.
